decision: Define Stage-0 exclusively as unmodified native Qwen. Move the tokenizer-extended zero-step control to Stage-1 and name it S1_INIT_CODEC_0STEP.
rationale: Adding location tokens or semantically initializing new embedding rows changes the model interface. Such a model is useful as the exact pre-tuning control for Stage-1, but it is not Stage-0 and must not be called native zero-shot.
supersedes: D004_SPLIT_STAGE0_NATIVE_AND_MATCHED_CONTROLS naming only; the two-control comparison remains, but the second control belongs to Stage-1.
reopen_condition: Any tokenizer or embedding modification in Stage-0 requires an explicit change to the definition of zero-shot and a new decision event.
